createWorkspace.title: Create a workspace
createWorkspace.description: A workspace has its own Instagram accounts, automations and team.
createWorkspace.name: Workspace name

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: How the workspace is named in the switcher and in invitations.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.nameHint: Everyone in the workspace sees this name.
workspace.savedDescription: Everyone in the workspace now sees “{name}”.

readOnly.title: Only owners and admins can change these settings
readOnly.description: Ask an owner or an admin of {workspace} to rename it.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Actions here take effect at once and cannot be undone.
danger.deleteDescription: Removes its Instagram connections, automations, contacts, conversations and history, for everyone in {workspace}.
danger.deleteDialogDescription: This permanently deletes every automation, contact, conversation and audit entry in {workspace}, and disconnects its Instagram accounts. Members lose access immediately.
danger.leaveDescription: You lose access to {workspace} until someone invites you again.
danger.leaveDialogDescription: You lose access to its automations, inbox and contacts. To come back, an owner or an admin has to invite you again.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who can work in this workspace, and what they may change.

readOnly.title: Only owners and admins can invite people and change roles
readOnly.description: Ask an owner or an admin of {workspace} to invite someone.

members.removeDialogDescription: {name} loses access at once. Their past replies and activity stay in the history.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: They get a link to join {workspace}. Each link works once and expires if it is not used.
invite.roleHint: Admins can connect accounts, invite people and change roles. Members work with automations, the inbox and contacts.
invite.sentDescription: We emailed {email} a link to join.
invite.linkDescription: Email is not set up on this installation, so nothing was sent. Send this link to {email} yourself. It works once and expires on {date}.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.label: Pending invitations
pending.emptyDescription: Invitations you send appear here until they are accepted.
pending.revokeDialogDescription: The link stops working at once. You can invite {email} again later.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who changed what in this workspace, newest first.
audit.label: Audit log
audit.emptyDescription: Changes to the workspace appear here as they happen.
audit.loadFailed: The audit log did not load
audit.noPermission: Only owners and admins can see the audit log
audit.noPermissionDescription: Ask an owner or an admin of {workspace} if you need to know who changed something.

automation.status_changed: Turned an automation on or off

inbox.message_sent: Sent a message from the inbox
